description.value: Charlie Brown's Health Foods is a family-owned local institution in Nanaimo, operating since 1971 and voted Best Health Food Store in the area. Located in a unit at 1533 Estevan Rd, it offers alternative and holistic health products and groceries. Touring cyclists looking to stock up on natural foods or specialty health items in Nanaimo will find this a long-established community staple.
